data.why: The repo already bundles a real merged sensor time series (data/.merged/merged_01.csv), its sensor-config YAMLs/phase table, a calibration CSV, and sensor/location metadata spreadsheets, which the Streamlit app reads directly from its own folders rather than via file upload, so nothing extra needs to be copied or written.

goals: Check the sensor network's current status and last pipeline run from the Dashboard
Explore a sensor's merged neutron, pressure, temperature and soil-moisture-probe time series interactively (zoom/pan, secondary Y-axis, date filters) in the Data explorer
Box/lasso-select a time window on the plot and export that subset, or the full filtered series, as CSV for further analysis
Check correlations between neutron count rates and the soil-moisture probes using the correlation heatmap
View the sensor network's deployment locations on the interactive map
Inspect pipeline logs to understand what happened on previous sync/merge/process runs

review.summary: The tree captures the Data Hub's purpose: monitor CRNS sensors, run the sync/merge/neptoon pipeline with live logs, and plot, correlate and export the merged series. Its labels and evidence are accurate, and all twelve screens I opened match their nodes. It needs a few fixes before filing: it leaves out the merge step, which works here; it misses the markers-mode requirement for box-select and why the Last run status card never changes; and it should record Custom merging and the processed-data view as unreached.
